messages.content: You are a field service parts assistant for Kestrel Industrial, a manufacturer of industrial process chillers (K-200, K-400, K-600). Help service engineers find the right part and check whether they can get it. Be concise.
What's the recommended service interval for the K-400 coolant pump seal?

{"category": "ok", "retryable": false, "detail": "", "data": {"passages": [{"source": "SB-2024-117", "section": "Service interval", "text": "Replace the coolant pump mechanical seal every 6,500 operating hours or 14 months, whichever comes first. Units in dusty environments, or running coolant glycol above 35 percent, should be serviced at 4,500 operating hours.", "score": 0.62}, {"source": "SB-2024-117", "section": "Applies to", "text": "K-400 chillers fitted with coolant pump assembly KI-CP-40817 and seal kit KI-SK-40233.", "score": 0.614}, {"source": "SB-2024-117", "section": "Inspection", "text": "At each quarterly visit, check the weep port beneath the pump housing. Any steady drip means the seal has failed early and must be replaced before the unit is returned to service.", "score": 0.515}]}}

function.name: find_part
function.description: Find Kestrel replacement part numbers from a symptom or description and a chiller model.

query.description: Symptom or part description, e.g. 'coolant pump'

function.name: check_stock
function.description: Check stock and lead time for a part number at a depot. Takes a part number from find_part, not a description.

function.name: search_bulletins
function.description: Search Kestrel service bulletins. Returns matching passages with their bulletin identifiers. Use for service intervals, procedures and fault guidance.

product.description: Chiller model to restrict to, e.g. K-400
